mainEntity.name: Is it safe to convert confidential PDFs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The file is processed in your browser and is never uploaded, so contracts, payslips and medical letters stay on your device.

mainEntity.name: Can I convert a scanned PDF to Word?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Turn on text recognition and choose the document language. Scans take longer than digital PDFs.

mainEntity.name: Will the formatting be the same?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exact layout keeps the look closest to the PDF. Editable text simplifies the layout so it is easier to edit.

mainEntity.name: Can I convert only some pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Enter a page range such as 1–3, 7 before converting.
You will be asked for the password. It is used only in your browser to open the file.
